data.name: A Bad Feeling
data.description:
Even the slightest change to ARC's behavior could spell disaster.

And that signal you heard? It's like nothing we've ever picked up. If they're up to something, we need to find out whatever we can.

data.name: A Balanced Harvest
data.description: Our food production is finally enough to meet our basic needs, but what we really need now is variety. I have a lead on some agricultural research from before the First Wave. Are you in?

data.name: A Better Use
data.description: We're short on everything but mouths to feed, yet Celeste's launching precious supplies into the air for Raiders to claw over. I’m done letting the good stuff go to waste.

data.name: A Dead End
data.description:
I… I don’t get it. One day they were trying to stave off the Collapse, and then, suddenly… Nothing.

That earthquake-resistant housing project was shut down by a group named MANTIKOR. Think you could find out more?

data.name: A First Foothold
data.description:
We’ve only just finished expanding the Tube network towards the Blue Gate, and we’re still laboring away at the rest.

My crew’s been building new infrastructure around the valley to safeguard our Raiders, but the constant ARC threat has made it difficult to get anything done.

data.name: A Lay of the Land
data.description:
Those distant rumbles are getting less distant with each passing day.

I have a lead on some LiDAR scanners that may help us monitor the tremors. You do want to keep a roof over your head, don’t you?

data.name: A New Type of Plant
data.description: Some scouts have been bringing back reports of these weird plants spreading into the area. Now, this makes your old pal Lance think it may have some interesting uses.

data.name: A Path Not Yours
data.description: Before our paths changed, we lingered by the Blue Gate for some time. We believe there is an old trail from those days, and something belonging to us may still lie at its end.

data.name: A Prime Specimen
data.description: That Deforester by the Blue Gate may have caused some real devastation, but a pristine husk like that is also an invaluable sample for our research.

data.name: A Reveal in Ruins
data.description: I got my hands on a fancy new ESR analyzer; had a whole big reveal planned. One minute it’s here, next minute—poof. Please help?

data.name: A Rising Tide
data.description: Says here there was a foreman at The Dam, who got recruited right after they canceled Project Heartwood. Got put in charge of some big reconstruction project.

data.name: A Symbol of Unification
data.description: Y’know, back in the day we actually used to have a flag - well, a scrap of cloth more than anything. Still, seeing it meant you knew you had allies nearby, that you were on your own home turf. So, I was thinking…

data.name: A Toxic Trail
data.description: We've got clean water again, but we can't risk people falling ill if the saboteurs return. We need to root them out once and for all.

data.name: A Warm Place To Rest
data.description: A customer of mine saw a family taking cover in an old encampment in Buried City. I'll pay anyone who manages to find them and escort them back to safety.

data.name: A Wrench in the Works
objectives: Search the buses near the western gate
Locate the stash of sabotage supplies hidden at the Water Towers
data.description: Looks like the resentment ended up reaching the ground staff of the Spaceport itself. A mutiny brewing, right in the heart of the Exodus.

objective_graph.description: Search the buses near the western gate
Locate the stash of sabotage supplies hidden at the Water Towers

data.name: Action Economy
data.description: The Hairpin wastes very little motion between shots. That sort of efficiency gets more interesting once a scope is involved.

objective_graph.description: Deal {0} damage with a Hairpin
Deal {0} damage with a Hairpin

data.name: After Rain Comes
data.description:
I know, I know! The power's down in sector—
Oh, hey. A flash flood took out some of our solar panels in Buried City, and the generators only hold on for so long.

Do us all a solid when you're up there, OK?

data.name: Armored Transports
data.description:
Ever since we expanded the tunnels to the Blue Gate, some rare pieces have started appearing on the black market.

Meanwhile, I'm stuck here peddling battered old Rattlers. If I don't find new supply lines, I'll be left in the dust.

data.name: Back on Top
data.description: Guess what? Shani asked me to help out with something, and for once, I’m actually glad she did. We’re setting up new outposts topside! Or, planning to, at least. Can you believe it?

data.name: Bait, Fetch, Blast
data.description: Tough nuts to crack, those Bullies. But you know, nothing’s indestructible. I’ve heard of a few tricks that might just work, care to put them to a test?

objective_graph.description: Destroy a Bully
Destroy a Bully
Destroy a Bully
Destroy the head of a Bully
Deliver a Bully Fragmenter to Apollo
Destroy {0} Bully legs

data.name: Battening Down
data.description: We’d hoped the seawalls at Riven Tides might offer us some protection from the elements, but it seems the hurricanes were not kind to this place, either.

data.name: Beam Resonance Tech
data.description: The Equalizer is at its best when the beam stays exactly where the target would rather not have it. Maybe we can work with that.

objective_graph.description: Deal {0} damage to Vaporizers with an Equalizer in one round
Deal {0} damage to Vaporizers with an Equalizer in one round

data.name: Bees!
data.description: Bees! There are bees still around! While I’m no expert, our greenhouse crew desperately wants some.

data.name: Belly of the Beast
data.description: ARC’s been swarming that fallen Emperor like flies on honey. I’m picking up signals from far beyond the Rust Belt, and they’re not slowing down.

data.name: Boarding the Frigate
data.description:
None of our old tactics work, facing those Frigates. We can’t run. We can’t hide. And there’s no waiting them out.

We need to take bold action, and we need to do it now.

objective_graph.description: Find a way on top of the Frigate
Establish a foothold on top of the Frigate
Damage a Hydra
Damage a Vaporizer
Damage a Rocketeer

data.name: Bombing Run
data.description: Now, time to see if that recon paid off. If we can teach Raiders to effectively counter Bombardiers up there, we’d be a lot safer down here.

data.name: Broken Monument
data.description: I have another special site I need you to search for me. An old battlegrounds, from the First Wave. Raiders nowadays usually pick places like that clean, despite the significance they once held. People forget quickly. Quicker than they should.

data.name: Building a Library
data.description: Our library selection has grown pretty stale. Could you head out to Buried City, and find something more for us to read? Make sure you bring something for everyone.

data.name: Burst Assembly Recovery
data.description: Shredders manage rapid volleys with little downtime. Careful dismantling with a Raider Tool might preserve the firing assembly long enough to figure out how.

objective_graph.description: Burst Assembly Recovery
Destroy {0} Shredders with a Raider Tool

data.name: Celeste’s Childhood Drawings
data.description:
Say, pal, has Celeste seemed a bit down, to you? 

Listen, I think I know something that might brighten her day. Do you know the hotel around Riven Tides?

data.name: Celeste’s Journals
data.description: Okay, so this is awkward… I lost two of my journals during some outpost inspections last time I went topside. Could you head out there and try to find them back before someone else stumbles on them?

data.name: Celeste's Teenage Rebellion
data.description:
Those Frigates looming in the sky… It made me feel shivers I haven’t felt since I was a girl. 

We need to adapt, I know. But the lessons we learned then? They're more relevant now than ever.

data.name: Clamoring for Attention
data.description: I think I've found something we might exploit. When bigger ARC machines are just far enough from each other, a well-timed distraction could pull one out of position. You want to test that idea?

data.name: Clean Hands
data.description: A matter remains at Pendola Pass which should have been settled by our own hands. That path is no longer open to us, so we must ask another.

data.name: Clearer Skies
data.description:
A swarm of disoriented Wasps crashed near one of our skylights.

I need you to help thin ARC's ranks before any more accidents happen, and gather some extra sturdy materials to fix the damage.

data.name: Cold Storage
data.description: Reports about Stella Montis keep coming in, and it’s unlike anything we’ve seen before. There may be records or relics from the past in there, and if so, I want them.

data.name: Collision Course
data.description: Many Raiders have learned how to dodge a Comet, but far too few know how to bring them down and get at their inner parts.

data.name: Combat Recon
data.description:
With those Bombardiers roaming around, ARC has found an entirely new way to flush Raiders out of cover. 

If you’re hoping to take one down, you’ll need to sharpen your skills and your strategy.

data.name: Communication Hideout
data.description: We've been losing signals in some areas of Buried City—my guess is that our equipment is acting up. You’re quite skilled with repairs, aren’t you? Could you check it out?

data.name: Compact Combustion Charges
data.description: Most explosives end with the detonation. Blaze Grenades have the good sense to keep causing trouble afterward. There may be something worth borrowing in that.

objective_graph.description: Deal {0} damage with Blaze Grenades

data.name: Deciphering The Data
data.description:
If the data you found can keep the ceiling from collapsing, we have no time to spare.

I know of a few magnetic decryptors around Acerra Spaceport, from back during the Exodus. They might still be working.

data.name: Digging Up Dirt
data.description: We caught a break. One of our scouts saw a member of the Tubes Management make a dead drop inside the Santa Maria Houses in the Buried City. This might be our chance to dig up some dirt on them for a change. You in?

data.name: Disrupting the Frigate
data.description: If we let those Frigates roam freely, they’ll hit Toledo sooner or later. Was there anything you spotted on top that could cause a distraction?

data.name: Doctor's Orders
data.description: Say, newbie: if you want me to treat you, you better prove that those precious limbs of yours are worth bandaging.

data.name: Dormant Barons
data.description:
During the First Wave, the Barons did more damage than all the other machines combined. Now they’re mere husks; fixed in place where they once fell... 

Still, their internals might hold the answer to keeping ARC at bay. So open one up, and bring me whatever is inside.

data.name: Down to Earth
data.description:
Raiders have long reported peculiar-looking crates dropping down from malfunctioning ARC Probes. 

If we can figure out a way to crack them open, we might get a better understanding of what it is they’re after.

data.name: Dust on the Wires
data.description: I sent a scout team to the Spaceport a while ago. Routine work — cataloging security, see if there's anything we could re-purpose. But I've heard nothing for two days.

data.name: Echoes of Victory Ridge
data.description: Did you feel any tremors last night? Me neither. But apparently the ground shifted at some point, and in the process it unearthed an old First Wave outpost that’d been blocked by debris. I’d like you to get in there quick, before anyone else does.

data.name: Embedded Blast Engineering
data.description: Armor does a good job against bullets. Small explosions are less respectful of the arrangement. Combining the two might be worth exploring.

objective_graph.description: Break ARC's armor plating {0} times using Light Impact Grenades
Deal {0} Damage to Fireflies using Light Impact Grenades
Deal {0} Damage to Hornets using Light Impact Grenades
Deal {0} Damage to Fireballs using Light Impact Grenades
Deal {0} Damage to Surveyors using Light Impact Grenades

data.name: Empathetic Prototypes
data.description: To think I may have kin just dangling in a shipment crate… What horror! What unspeakable horror!

data.name: Espresso
data.description: A Raider came into my shop earlier, to trade some grenades for a machine she found in Buried City. She said it makes coffee, but it seems to be missing a few parts. Up for a job?

data.name: Exploring Pendola Pass
data.description: ARC’s always been drawn to gunfire and commotion, but we’ve never seen them quite converge on a place like they have at Pendola Pass.

objective_graph.description: Destroy {0} ARC enemies
Use 1 Wire to patch into the antenna on top of the tallest tower in the Railyard
Search the control room at the Cielo Sereno Observatory for power
Search {0} containers inside the Commissary Supermarket

data.name: Extended Burst Cycles
data.description: A burst has a beginning, a middle, and an end. The middle could probably use more bullets. Let's investigate.

objective_graph.description: Deal {0} damage with a Burst Burletta or Charged Burst Aphelion
Deal {0} damage with a Burst Burletta or Charged Burst Aphelion

data.name: Eyes in the Sky
data.description: Those LiDAR scanners you found work best when put in high locations. I’ve identified a few good spots around the Rust Belt; hope you’re surefooted.

data.name: Eyes on the Prize
data.description: Everything’s been calm around my drop-offs since you helped out, but that doesn’t mean it’ll stay that way for long. I’ve set up surveillance at one of my most used spots in Buried City, to prevent future tampering. Only problem is, it needs power to go live.

data.name: Flickering Threat
data.description: My usual engineer is still healing from his wounds, and has been loopy for days. We can’t afford to be at half-grid until he heals; I need someone to pick up his wrench in the mean time.

data.name: Fragmented Logs
data.description: Now that we’ve found our footing on Stella Montis, several parties are interested in digging a bit deeper and seeing what we can find out about the past of this place. To do so, however, we’ll need to power up some of these old machines so we can start to sift through the data.

data.name: Furtive Meetings
data.description: I’m still sorting through the data you found in Stella Montis, but something’s caught my eye. I’d like you to look into it.

data.name: Greasing Her Palms
data.description:
Recently, I’ve been trying and failing to get Tian Wen to join our community projects.

I may have to sweeten the deal. She’s been complaining about the quality of salvage found on the market; think we could do her a solid?

data.name: Groundbreaking
data.description: Data or no data: we’ll learn how to make this place earthquake-proof. With a research this in-depth, there’s bound to be a paper trail somewhere.

data.name: Hatch Repairs
data.description: Our scouts have reported several Raider Hatches with leaking hydraulic pipes. They still work, but not for long. Mind patching one up, next time you’re out there?

data.name: High-Voltage Exposure
data.description: Some ARC machines appear capable of absorbing energy before putting it back to use. The same principle might be worth testing on something a little less insulated.

objective_graph.description: High-Voltage Exposure
Destroy {0} ARC Turbines

data.name: Home to Roost
objectives: Reach the back of the Blue Gate tunnels
Scan any Android in the back of the Traffic Tunnels
Head to the MANTIKOR locker room
Search the locker room for any clues
Read the last vehicle weighing logs
Transmit MANTIKOR's security last recordings to Shani
data.description: All of these old logs mention mutinies being repressed by MANTIKOR… Then suddenly, nothing. The entries just stop, a few weeks before the Exodus.

objective_graph.description: Reach the back of the Blue Gate tunnels
Scan any Android in the back of the Traffic Tunnels
Head to the MANTIKOR locker room
Search the locker room for any clues
Read the last vehicle weighing logs
(Optional) Find the hidden key
Enter the Confiscation Room
Transmit MANTIKOR's security last recordings to Shani

data.name: In My Image
data.description: I just treated one of the first Raiders who visited Stella Montis, and she said that she saw... others. Androids, very much like me.

data.name: Industrial Espionage
data.description: With my own stashes secured, I think it might be time to keep a closer eye on the competition so this doesn’t happen again.

data.name: Into the Fray
data.description:
It used to be their world, up there. Nobody to challenge their claim. 

Yet here we are. More outposts. More intel. More firepower. If I didn’t know better, I’d say we’ve got quite a bit of fight left in us.

objective_graph.description: Destroy {0} Leaper legs

data.name: Keeping an Eye Out
data.description:
I’m looking for someone. Bilguun. You might’ve seen him around, but chances are you haven’t. He’s… not the most sociable person around, you see.

He spends a lot of time Topside, but usually returns to Speranza regularly to check in.

data.name: Keeping the Memory
data.description: I lost my cool a bit when I sent you after that trap. I don’t usually lose my temper, but the First Wave… We went through a lot, back then. Lost a lot of people. It’s still a bit of a raw wound for me, but I want you to understand.

data.name: Last Entry
data.description: More mentions of MANTIKOR, and more clear signs of dissent among the researchers. I suspect tensions eventually escalated.

data.name: Life of a Pharmacist
data.description: This place could use a makeover, but I don’t want it looking like your raggedy Raider Dens. See if you can find out how my fellow medical greats used to live.

data.name: Line in the Sand
data.description: That Stella Montis hard drive contained more than just the shutdown documentation - it also had the transport schedules of some pretty critical Exodus components.

data.name: Lost in Transmission
data.description: I have equipment set up at the Spaceport, to monitor ARC’s movements. My connection broke down just now — I need you to head to the Control Towers and help me retrieve my logs.

data.name: Magazine Geometry 101
data.description: A standard magazine does its job, but it can only hold so much. Getting familiar with a drum-fed design could reveal how that extra room is put to use, and where the same idea might fit elsewhere.

objective_graph.description: Magazine Geometry 101
Destroy {0} Bastions with a Rattler
Deal {0} damage to a Bastion with a Rattler

data.name: Marked for Death
data.description: Someone has been lifting supplies from my drop-off point in Buried City. I’ve set up a trap, but I need someone to check it for me.

data.name: Market Correction
data.description: That theft before? Doesn’t look like a coincidence anymore. Some of the competition from Toledo is setting up shop where they don’t belong. I want their cache sabotaged, preferably before they get too comfortable.

data.name: Medical Merchandise
data.description: I’ve become quite crafty at weaving bandages from Fabric, but to my shame, I haven’t quite mastered weaving an x-ray machine or a pulse oximiter.

data.name: Mixed Signals
data.description:
Have you spotted any Surveyors; the big round ones? 

They seem to be transmitting data back into orbit, and I can’t help but think it's tied to that signal we picked up. Will you break one open, so we can try to decipher the data?

data.name: Movie Night
data.description: Everyone's been on edge ever since rumors of that ARC signal spread. I was thinking a movie night would be a great distraction, but I'm missing some crucial supplies. You'll help me out, yeah?

data.name: Nothing Gained
data.description: Heard you’re looking to pick a fight with the big girls. Bring your best gear, but don’t think that alone will cut it.

objective_graph.description: Destroy a Matriarch
Destroy a Queen
Deliver a Queen Reactor to Apollo
Deliver a Matriarch Reactor to Apollo

data.name: Nothing Ventured
data.description: There was a time I’d tell you tell stay well away from Queens and Matriarchs, but these days… I wish we still had that luxury.

objective_graph.description: Destroy {0} Comets
Destroy {0} Rocketeers
Destroy {0} Sentinels
Deliver {0} Comet Igniters to Apollo
Deliver {0} Rocketeer Drivers to Apollo
Deliver {0} ARC Circuitry to Apollo
Deliver {0} ARC Motion Cores to Apollo
Destroy a Bombardier on Buried City
Destroy a Bastion on Stella Montis

data.name: Off The Radar
data.description: The damage down here was pretty bad, but our Topside infrastructure was hit even harder. I still have several antennas that stopped working after the storm.

data.name: On Deaf Ears
objectives: Find the researcher's guest logs on the reception computers
Find where the researcher held their lecture, and access their notes
Find information about the prototypes on the Medical Research computers
data.description:
Seems like every other Raider here has some serious hearing damage.

I heard rumors they developed some extra advanced hearing aids at Stella Montis. If you can track them down, we might all be able to use our indoor voices, for once.

objective_graph.description: Find the researcher's guest logs on the reception computers
Find where the researcher held their lecture, and access their notes
Find information about the prototypes on the Medical Research computers

data.name: On The Map
data.description: We know the coordinates for those hearing aids, but I’ll have to cross-reference them with a paper map of the Spaceport. Those legs of yours aren’t too tired, are they?

data.name: Our Presence up There
data.description: ARC may be changing, but we’re finally changing with it. Let’s finish up those outposts and revolutionize the way we track them, flank them, and smash them to bits.

data.name: Out of the Shadows
data.description: Did you see the flags? The time for cowering is over. You’ve been more than battle-tested, from what I hear; think you can take on a Rocketeer?

data.name: Outstanding Balance
data.description:
I had a deal for a Bastion Cell lined up with a Raider called Dodger, but he's gone quiet. 

I need someone to track down his stash before some scavenger stumbles into it. Interested?

data.name: Paving the Way
data.description: For an entire sector to collapse like that… No wonder people are scared. We need to reinforce beyond anything we’ve done before, and we can’t do it alone.

data.name: Picking Up The Pieces
data.description: The storm has mostly settled, but much of our infrastructure has taken a proper beating. If you're hoping to stay with us, I'll need you to pull your weight in the repair efforts.

data.name: Power Out
data.description: This goes beyond bad luck. Something—or someone—has knocked out some of our electrical substations. The engineer I sent out to fix it hasn’t returned, so I need all available Raiders to look into it. That includes you.

data.name: Prescriptions of the Past
data.description: I’ve been curious about the medical area in the Spaceport for a while now. Something tells me it’s got just what I need to become the undeniable champion of this place.

data.name: Reduced to Rubble
data.description: That collapsed highway worries me; it looks to be recent. Much of Topside may be in ruins, but most of it is from ages ago.

data.name: Ruins and Reverberations
data.description: That Emperor didn’t just trip and fall… It was brought down. And I have a leading theory about how that happened.

data.name: Safe Harbor
data.description: Seems like news of the train derailment spread fast… And drove many workers to stash some very tasty technology away from prying eyes.

data.name: Safe Passage
data.description:
I heard rumors about some signal Shani picked up. ARC is constantly adapting, and I'm sure this won’t be their last warning sign.

Well, if it’s an arms race they want, they can get one.

data.name: Settled in Full
data.description: Lucky for you, Dodger's debt can still be settled. Bring me a Bastion Cell. A real one, pulled from a real Bastion. Consider what Dodger owed me transferred to credit for you. Okay?

data.name: Shield Stress Testing
data.description: Sustained damage could reveal exactly what makes a shield give out, and how to make that happen faster. For science, naturally.

objective_graph.description: Shield Stress Testing
Deal {0} damage to encountered Raiders

data.name: Shoring Up Defenses
data.description:
The wide-open coastline used to mean danger, but now it's the only place we can spot new threats moving into the Rust Belt.

So we'll have to make our own cover, and reinforce what few defenses we can find.

data.name: Sizing Things Up
data.description: Those Emperors were imposing enough from a distance, but to be able to get so up close… If there was ever a time to tread carefully, this would be it.

data.name: Snap and Salvage
data.description: All of Speranza is buzzing about Stella Montis right now, and I admit it’s caught my attention. Let the others sort out the whats and hows; I’m interested in the tech inside.

data.name: Solid-Core Casting Tech
data.description: Shotgun engagements against drones offer a useful test of stopping power. Concentrating the full charge into a single projectile could produce far more decisive results.

objective_graph.description: Destroy {0} Flying ARC using shotguns
Destroy {0} Flying ARC using shotguns

data.name: Someone Else's Shoes
data.description: Those androids around Stella Montis… It seems they were test subjects as much as they were assistants. There’s some encrypted research notes about a… Project Pathos.

data.name: Source of the Contamination
data.description: I’m not saying our water’s been tampered with, but based on your samples, I can’t rule out the possibility either. Would you return to the Dam and see what’s wrong?

data.name: Sparks Fly
data.description:
Those Hornet stings can really mess you up, if you’re unlucky. And even if you destroy one, you’re still wasting a ton of ammo.

I’ve been working on a more elegant way to bring them down. Care to make some sparks fly?

objective_graph.description: Destroy a Hornet with a Trigger 'Nade or Snap Blast
Destroy a Hornet using any Grenade
Destroy a Hornet with a Trigger 'Nade or Snap Blast

data.name: Sprint Shooting
data.description: Fast movement is useful right up until a weapon needs to come into play. A weapon that keeps up with the pace would be useful.

objective_graph.description: Visit {0} locations on Pendola Pass
Visit the Electrical Substation
Visit the Truck Stop
Visit the Old Town
Visit the Almatera Station
Visit the Researcher Lodgings
Visit the Deep-Space Telescope
Visit the Commissary Supermarket

data.name: Stable Housing
data.description: You like a certain amount of uncertainty, right? A client wants the contents of a locked safe in Stella Montis. It's intact, so whatever's inside has been there since before the Exodus. Interested?

data.name: Straight Record
data.description: Back during the First Wave, my squad and I built a trap out by the Dam. Overloaded a generator, turned it into a makeshift ARC trap. Now I hear Raiders are using it to cut comms and spring ambushes on each other. I need you to end it.

data.name: Switching the Supply
data.description: There is a reservoir beneath the Spaceport; if we manage to route that water here, that should buy us time to deal with the contamination.

data.name: Taking Stock
data.description: On the surface, our paths seldom cross by design. After all, your presence draws more eyes than ours can afford.

objective_graph.description: On Stella Montis, take a photo of the sculpture in the Atrium
Deliver {0} Industrial Batteries to the Nomadic Envoy
On Dam Battlegrounds, ping a Bombardier
On Buried City, ping a Bastion
On Spaceport, take a photo of a Baron Husk

data.name: Targeted Component Trial
data.description: Even the toughest machines have their weak spots. Consistent strikes against vulnerable components could reveal a way to develop rounds that hit them where it hurts most. Metaphorically speaking.

objective_graph.description: Targeted Component Trial
Destroy {0} thrusters on flying ARC enemies

data.name: Test Case
data.description: Hey, question for you. What do you get if you cross a Hornet and Fireball? If your answer is ‘a Firefly’, then we’re on the same page.

data.name: The Clean Dream
data.description: You know what I've been dreaming of lately? A talking water distiller! Crazy, huh? But seriously, with purer compounds I could make explosives with more oumph! Would be something, right?

data.name: The First Nomads
data.description: That sphere you spotted in the Outskirts Bunker… They remind me of those eerie contraptions that the Nomads have been leaving in their wake.

data.name: The League
data.description:
Kids around here have been kicking empty grenade casings around. It’s only a matter of time before they’re not so empty.

So here’s the plan. You help me with some prep work, and I’ll set up an actual football team for the young ones.

data.name: The Major’s Footlocker
data.description:
I have another job. It’s.. about my mom.

Those First Wave sites I sent you to before? I actually hoped you’d find something of my mother’s. She fought in the Raider resistance. It was a long shot; but now I've got an actual lead.

data.name: The Right Tool
data.description: You're one of the new arrivals, right? I need a volunteer to test out this upgraded Ferro; should cut through ARC plating like butter. Go put holes in some machines, and report back to me.

data.name: The Root of the Matter
data.description: We're in luck. The notes you found last time were written by the lead researcher. When the project went under, it seems she took some of the seed samples and sealed them away in a secure location.

data.name: The Stench of Corruption
data.description: That key you found in the barrel truck… I won’t jump to accusations just yet, but this certainly reeks of an inside job. Could you investigate a hunch I have?

data.name: The Trifecta
data.description: Intel’s all well and good, but it only gets us so far. If ARC’s truly closing in, I need every Raider to prove they can handle their drones in a fight.

objective_graph.description: Destroy {0} Wasps
Destroy {0} Snitches
Destroy a Firefly fuel tank
Destroy {0} Wasp thrusters
Destroy {0} Hornets

data.name: Thermite-Tipped Rounds
data.description: Impact damage is useful. Setting the problem on fire afterward feels like a reasonable improvement.

data.name: To The Skies
data.description: Shani’s content for the gondolas to get us up and down the mountain, but we have some engineers from Ferrovia more willing to take a risk. I can get behind that.

data.name: Top Mounted Optics Retrofittings
data.description: Elevated firing positions provide clear sightlines. Osprey field data under those conditions could support development of improved magnification.

data.name: Tracks of the Beast
data.description: The stretch from the Northern tracks to the Emperor is crawling with unfamiliar ARC units. I need eyes on them, or we might be stepping into a death trap before we can even begin to breach the Emperor.

data.name: Trash Into Treasure
data.description:
There's no such thing as junk, to a Raider; just valuable materials waiting to be recycled.

If you're going to amount to anything around here, you can't just wait for things to be served on a silver platter.

data.name: Tribute to Toledo
data.description: The Official Toledo Tubes Management is demanding one of our Power Rods for usage of “their” Slingshot tubes. Don’t let the name fool you, they’re in no way official; just thugs with lots of power. Could you help me with this?

data.name: Trigger Reset Systems
data.description: Fast-moving threats leave little margin for hesitation. Close encounters with Skulkers could reveal ways to improve paced combat effectiveness.

objective_graph.description: Destroy {0} Skulkers with a Raider Tool
Destroy {0} Skulkers with a Raider Tool

data.name: Turnabout
data.description: I got a plan. If we recover the evidence against the OTTM before they get to it, we might get them off our backs once and for all.

data.name: Unexpected Initiative
data.description: I’m setting up a greenhouse, to help boost our food production. I’m doing Celeste a solid, alright? That’s all. But enough about that. I’ve got all the details worked out, but I’ll need supplies, and I’m not hauling them alone.

data.name: Untended Garden
data.description: According to the files you found in the lab, the cultivation researchers were actually the ones who set up the hydroponic domes out in the swamp. Sounds like the most obvious place to search next, don’t you think?

data.name: Waking the Grid
data.description: There's a problem with our sensor coverage at the Spaceport. The security grid is old, so maybe it's just acting up. If you could get it running again, it'd save me a lot of sleepless nights.

data.name: Water Troubles
data.description: If you’re here to complain about the water, join the club. I’ve been fielding complaints all day. Something is definitely up with it, and I need some help to sort it out.

data.name: What Goes Around
data.description:
We can't build ARC tech from scratch, but there's plenty I can tinker from the pieces you salvage.

I'm currently trying to repurpose different ARC parts. Would you mind running some experiments for me?

data.name: What We Left Behind
data.description: Celeste told me you’re the one who helped her hound me about pitching in more. I’ll say this once: I don’t appreciate the meddling, and I have my own reasons for refusing. I do, however, appreciate the scrap. Since you’re apparently good at tracking it down, I may have a task for you.

data.name: When Everything Falls
data.description:
The box you found in the MANTIKOR facility contained specialized radios, encrypted using geotags.

And the coordinates… They start right where the mutineers stashed their weapons.

data.name: Wires Crossed
data.description: That contraption you found at the Observatory… There wasn’t much data left to read, but the signature was undeniably ARC’s.

objective_graph.description: On The Blue Gate, attach a Snitch Scanner to the antenna at Pilgrim’s Peak
On Spaceport, attach a Surveyor Vault to the antenna on top of the Launch Towers
On Buried City, attach a Sentinel Firing Core to the antenna at the roof of the Grandioso Apartments

data.name: With A Trace
data.description: That downed machine… We weren’t the ones who did that. We know that there are stray survivors out there, but this? This goes far beyond a single person.

data.name: With a View
data.description:
Have you ever noticed those streaks of light darting across the skies? 

I’ve seen too much to believe they’re natural, but it’ll take more than a hunch to convince Celeste.

data.name: Worth Your Salt
data.description: I found notes that some electrical engineers at the Spaceport were working on advanced, salt-based batteries. If we can get our hands on one, perhaps it’ll prevent full-scale power outages next time a ceiling comes crashing down.
